items.title: Uber Eats starts drone deliveries in Texas

items.lede: Uber Eats is officially launching drone delivery in partnership with Zipline starting Tuesday. The initial rollout begins in the Houston suburb of Spring, Texas, with Dallas next in line and dozens of additional US cities planned. items.title: Uber and Zipline’s drone delivery service takes flight in Houston

items.lede: The two companies want to make one million deliveries per day using Zipline drones by the end of 2029.
